phases.title: Fix Bug 1: move sort after filter in useFilteredProducts.ts
phases.notes: Moved sort block to after the filter blocks. Changed products.sort() to result.sort() so we sort the already-filtered array, not the full list. Build passes; 5 test files still pass; 2 test files (sorting, derivedStateCorrectness) still fail due to Bugs 2 & 3 (pre-existing, not regressions).

phases.title: Fix Bug 2 & 3: use non-mutating sort and add sortBy to useMemo deps
phases.notes: Changed result.sort() to [...result].sort() to avoid mutating the array. Added sortBy to the useMemo dependency array. All 21 tests pass; build succeeds.

phases.title: Run derivedStateCorrectness tests and verify all three bugs are fixed
phases.notes: All 21 tests pass (7 test files: derivedStateCorrectness, app.render, loadingError, clearFilters, sorting, pagination, filtering). Build succeeds. All three bugs confirmed fixed.
